exec: Who leads CISA, and how well it is funded, affects the federal alerts and support US organisations rely on.
org: Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee
plain: The person nominated to run the US cyber defence agency CISA faced Senate questions on staffing cuts and readiness for a major cyberattack.
summary: Newsweek reports that Michael LoSapio, nominated to lead CISA, was questioned at a Senate Homeland Security committee hearing. Sen. Elissa Slotkin said she fears a 'cyber 9/11' and asked about CISA staffing and budget cuts. Newsweek says LoSapio promised to consider a 'gap analysis' and return to Congress for more resources if needed. Newsweek notes CISA has had no Senate-confirmed director since Jen Easterly left in January 2025.
title: CISA director nominee questioned at Senate hearing over 'cyber 9/11' fears

validation.note: One established outlet (Newsweek) read; the MSN copy is a syndicated version of the same report.

review.note: Softened gap analysis to 'promised to consider' as Newsweek words it; attributed the no-confirmed-director statement to Newsweek (Easterly left Jan 2025). Nominee, Slotkin cyber 9/11 quote, hearing date match.
